patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,2 +1,46 @@
-def recite(start_verse: int, end_verse: int) -> list[str]:
-    pass
+def recite(start_verse: int, end_verse: int) -> list[str]:
+    animals = [
+        ("fly", ""),
+        ("spider", "It wriggled and jiggled and tickled inside her."),
+        ("bird", "How absurd to swallow a bird!"),
+        ("cat", "Imagine that, to swallow a cat!"),
+        ("dog", "What a hog, to swallow a dog!"),
+        ("goat", "Just opened her throat and swallowed a goat!"),
+        ("cow", "I don't know how she swallowed a cow!"),
+        ("horse", "She's dead, of course!")
+    ]
+    
+    result = []
+    
+    for i in range(start_verse, end_verse + 1):
+        animal, comment = animals[i - 1]
+        verse = [f"I know an old lady who swallowed a {animal}."]
+        
+        if comment:
+            verse.append(comment)
+        
+        if i == 8:  # Horse verse is special
+            verse.append("She's dead, of course!")
+        else:
+            # Add the cumulative part
+            for j in range(i - 1, 0, -1):
+                current_animal = animals[j][0]
+                previous_animal = animals[j - 1][0]
+                
+                if j == 1:  # Special case for spider-fly
+                    verse.append(f"She swallowed the {current_animal} to catch the {previous_animal}.")
+                else:
+                    if j == 2:  # Spider has special description
+                        verse.append(f"She swallowed the {current_animal} to catch the {previous_animal} that wriggled and jiggled and tickled inside her.")
+                    else:
+                        verse.append(f"She swallowed the {current_animal} to catch the {previous_animal}.")
+            
+            verse.append("I don't know why she swallowed the fly. Perhaps she'll die.")
+        
+        result.extend(verse)
+        
+        # Add empty string after each verse except the last one
+        if i < end_verse:
+            result.append("")
+    
+    return result
